concern_summary: The concern encompasses the user interaction mechanics of a menu item, specifically managing visual state changes in response to user actions like hover and press, highlighting its active state.
This concern deals with the rendering and management of menu items, including their properties such as titles, descriptions, and interaction states like highlighting and enabling/disabling.
This concern focuses on determining the appropriate cursor style based on the interactive state of components.
This concern is responsible for managing the display of menu items related to account switching, providing users with options relevant to their available accounts.
This concern deals with managing pointer events and calculating positions for popovers or context menus based on the current pointer or cursor location.
This concern involves displaying user-related information within a menu item's tooltip, ensuring the correct association of the user's display name with their account for proper visibility.

This concern encompasses functionalities related to the management and display of an overflow menu. It includes options for tax exemption as well as actions for changing payment card and currency, allowing users to select relevant actions from a unified overflow menu interface.
This concern encompasses the functionalities related to the generation and display of skeleton items in the user interface, which serve as placeholders to indicate loading content for menu items.
This concern manages settings and options related to integrations with various accounting software, allowing users to toggle features and navigate through settings.
